English: Perch Post
A makeshift wooden post for tethering hunting eagles, marking the beginning of the tribes eagle-taming tradition.
Eagle Stand
A cluster of heavy timber stands, allowing for more eagles and greater prestige among the tribe.
Hunting Perch
A raised wooden platform for eagle trainers and lookouts, supporting a larger population and faster mobilization.
Falconers Tent
A grand felt tent for the master falconer, providing for the care and breeding of eagles and increased manpower.
Training Platform
A robust wooden structure for intensive eagle training and horsemanship, fostering rapid growth and unity.
Eagle Pavilion
A semi-permanent wooden pavilion, richly decorated, that serves as a center for eagle festivals and tribal gatherings.
Hunting Chamber
A multi-chambered structure of wood and leather, hosting the greatest eagle masters and affording supreme horde growth.
Master Eyrie
A fortified, multi-level wooden eyrie that houses the most prized eagles and serves as a rallying point for the entire clan.
High Hunters Hall
A grand hall raised above the camp, reserved for the high hunter and clan elders, inspiring all warriors and boosting the clans spirit.
Altaic Eagle Sanctuary
A legendary sanctuary at the heart of the Altaic camp, where eagles nest undisturbed and the unity of the clan is absolute.
